facts.business: Welspun Enterprises Limited is an infrastructure company engaged in Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) and Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects across Transport, Water, and Tunneling & Rehabilitation sectors.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to significant management judgement in estimating total contract costs, stage of completion, and contract variations/claims
facts.related_party_note: Subsidiaries include Dewas Waterprojects Works Private Limited, Welspun Sattanathapuram Nagapattinam Road Private Limited, Welspun Aunta-Simaria Project Private Limited, and Welspun Michigan Engineering Limited (WMEL). The Group holds equity shares and compulsorily convertible debentures (CCDs) in these entities.
